title: Gateway default TUN route still narrows native profile to 0202::/16
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs documents the exact canonical 0200::/8 native profile, and Gateway::is_local_mesh recognizes all 0x02 addresses, but default_ipv6_prefix() and Config::default_sim() still return 0202::/16. lichend passes this prefix directly to tun::configure, so a default deployment installs only a /16 route and fails to deliver the other 255/256 of valid key-derived native addresses. Change both defaults to 0200::/8 and add configuration/routing regression coverage.
